universities.name: UNSW Sydney
universities.living: Visa minimum A$29,710 a year; UNSW says Sydney costs run from under A$30,000 to over A$70,000 depending on lifestyle
universities.english: Taught in English · IELTS 6.5 overall, no sub-score below 6.0
universities.scholarships: 20% tuition contribution for eligible countries; Scientia awards (full tuition or A$20,000 a year)
universities.selective: Acceptance rate not published; offers are made in grouped rounds

universities.name: University of Melbourne
universities.tuition: Set per course — see the official 2026 fee tables; a deposit of A$17,000 is paid when accepting an undergraduate offer
universities.living: Visa minimum A$29,710 a year (see Melbourne’s cost-of-living page for detail)
universities.fields: Life sciences and medicine, arts and humanities, social sciences and management
universities.scholarships: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship: 20% fee sponsorship from 2027 (25% before) for citizens of countries with GDP per capita of US$10,000 or less
universities.deadline: February (Semester 1) and July (Semester 2) intakes — see the official dates

universities.name: University of Queensland
universities.living: Rent from A$170 a week (large share house) to A$564 a week (1-bedroom); books about A$1,212 a year
universities.english: Taught in English · IELTS 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each band
universities.fields: Mining engineering, agriculture, veterinary science, environmental science
universities.deadline: Semester 1: November 30 of the previous year; Semester 2: May 31

universities.name: RMIT University
universities.living: About A$45,000 a year (RMIT cost-of-living calculator)
universities.english: Taught in English · IELTS set per course — see RMIT’s English requirements
universities.fields: Architecture, art and design, computer science, engineering
universities.scholarships: Scholarships for commencing international students (RMIT awards more than 2,000 scholarships a year)
universities.deadline: Semester 1 2027 applications opened August 3, 2026; accepted until places are filled

universities.name: Macquarie University
universities.tuition: Commencement fee A$16,000–23,500 (deducted from first-session fees); use the fee calculator for your course
universities.living: Course expenses A$850–1,000 a year; visa minimum A$29,710
universities.english: Taught in English · IELTS 6.5 overall for most courses (higher for law, medicine, education)
universities.fields: Linguistics, philosophy, classics, data science and AI
universities.scholarships: Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship: up to A$10,000 (undergraduate ATAR-equivalent of 85+)
universities.deadline: Applications open year-round or until places are filled

universities.name: Curtin University
universities.tuition: Indicative fee not listed for the Bachelor of Commerce — use Curtin’s fee calculator
universities.living: Budget at least A$475 a week for a single student in Perth
universities.english: Taught in English · IELTS 6.0 overall and in each band (Bachelor of Commerce)
universities.fields: Mineral and mining engineering, geology, earth and marine sciences
universities.scholarships: John Curtin Global Excellence: 40% off tuition; a 20% tuition scholarship; Curtin International Scholarship: A$10,000 credit

universities.name: Griffith University
universities.tuition: Indicative annual fee is shown in Griffith’s degree finder — see the official page
universities.living: Visa minimum A$29,710 a year; Griffith says South East Queensland is more affordable than other major cities
universities.english: Taught in English · IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0
universities.fields: Hospitality and tourism, nursing, sports-related subjects
universities.scholarships: 20% off tuition for eligible international students; Academic Excellence scholarship: 25% off, applied automatically
universities.deadline: Applications open year-round for most programs
